text:
jordan: quick thread — we need a safe, long-lived plan to untangle the runtime <-> request-router dependency. proposing a phased checklist. cc @maya @ranjit :wave:

maya: +1. buckets? curious how much of the hotpath we can keep untouched on phase 1.

ranjit: agree. prefer small, verifiable slices. my mental model: 1) read-only adapter extract, 2) config and metrics surface split, 3) moving stateful pieces off hotpath. each phase should have a clear rollback.

jordan: exactly. draft checklist I'm thinking about: 
- phase marker + goal (what's extracted)
- required contracts (proto/http/schema)
- consumer shim (compat layer)
- tests: unit, integration, end-to-end with synthetic load
- canary plan + SLO delta guardrails
- observability and tracing mapping
- deploy/playbook + rollback steps
- owner & ETA

pri: can we add a small example of a compat shim? something like:
```
# shim pseudo
class RouterShim:
    def route(req):
        # translate old headers -> new API
        return new_router.call(translated_req)
```
keep it tiny so we can iterate.

maya: good. also add cost/latency measurement targets for each phase. we don't want subtle regressions. maybe require a <5% p50 delta and explicit approval if more.

ranjit: +1 on metrics. also add a test that injects a simulated KV cache miss to ensure behavior under tail-case loads.

jordan: safety net idea: feature-flagged path with auto-fallback after N errors or latency threshold. something like: 
- flag=modular_runtime_enabled
- fallback_count window=5min, threshold=1% errors or p95 increase > 200ms
- auto revert if tripped

infra-bot: deploy-bot: note: when creating canaries, tag targets with `dep-untangle=true` and ensure rollout-circuit-breaker hook exists.

pri: one more operational item: runbook section for oncall — include quick commands:
```
# check canary health
kubectl get hpa -l dep-untangle=true
curl -sS http://canary-metrics/summary | jq .errors
```

maya: team boundaries: runtime team approves kernel-level changes, router team owns the surface contracts. we need an explicit CR signoff step in the checklist.

jordan: timeline proposal: 6 sprints, each sprint = one phase/subphase. first sprint = read-only adapter + compat shim + basic e2e.

ranjit: realistic risk list: hidden sync points (session lifecycle), misrouted telemetry, config drift. mitigation: short syncs with owners + automated conformance tests.

pri: +1 — I'll draft the conformance test harness (small repo) and protos for shim.

jordan: awesome. next actions: @maya to own phase gating criteria, @ranjit to enumerate integration tests, @pri to sketch shim and harness. i'll put a PR with the checklist in the repo and link to this thread. :thumbsup:

maya: sounds good. please include a one-paragraph rollback rationale for each phase (why rollback is safe).

jordan: will do. thanks all.
